delay_customer_text.0: Delayed due to airline internal processes.
delay_customer_text.1: Delayed due to late passenger check-in.
delay_customer_text.2: Delayed due to passenger rebooking or ticketing.
delay_customer_text.3: Delayed due to a passenger-related safety concern.
delay_customer_text.4: Delayed due to a passenger with reduced mobility.
delay_customer_text.6: Delayed due to cargo or mail handling.
delay_customer_text.9: Delayed due to documentation or weight and balance.
delay_customer_text.11: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to accommodate late customer check-ins.
delay_customer_text.13: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to load oversized items or those that require special handling on to the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.14: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to board all of the customers and complete the check-in processes at the airport gate.
delay_customer_text.15: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to board customers with a late connection or arrival and complete the check-in processes at the airport gate.
delay_customer_text.17:
This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to resolve a catering issue. 

An example of a catering issue could include having the incorrect quantity of meals needed for the number of customers on the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.18: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to load late-arriving customer baggage on to the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.19: This flight is delayed due to additional boarding time needed to support customers requiring special assistance.
delay_customer_text.25: This flight is delayed due to late planning or processing of cargo.
delay_customer_text.31: Your flight is delayed due to additional flight preparation time needed to complete the aircraft documentation required for the flight to depart.
delay_customer_text.32:
This flight is delayed due to ground handling activities which are taking longer than anticipated. 

Examples of ground handling activities could include lavatory/water servicing, loading/unloading the aircraft, or arranging for equipment to service your aircraft.
delay_customer_text.35: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to clean the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.36: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to refuel the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.37:
This flight is delayed due to a catering issue that is taking longer than anticipated to resolve. 

An example of a catering issue could include the late arrival of catering to the aircraft, an incorrect order, or a missing food item.
delay_customer_text.41:
This flight is delayed due to a maintenance issue with the aircraft that needs to be resolved. 

An example of a maintenance issue could include the need to complete a minor aircraft repair or last-minute maintenance inspection.
delay_customer_text.42: This flight is delayed due to a scheduled maintenance issue with the aircraft that is taking longer than anticipated.
delay_customer_text.43:
This flight is delayed due to an unscheduled maintenance issue within the aircraft that needs to be resolved. 

An example of a maintenance issue could include repairing a broken seat, the in-flight entertainment system console or other components within the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.44: This flight is delayed due to an unforeseen technical issue with the maintenance equipment needed to service the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.45: This flight is delayed due to the late arrival of maintenance parts or equipment needed to service the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.46:
This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to substitute the aircraft. 

Due to an unforeseen maintenance issue, the aircraft for your flight may have had to be changed, and the arrival of the replacement aircraft took longer than expected.
delay_customer_text.47:
This flight is delayed due to aircraft availability. 

Due to an unforeseen maintenance issue, the aircraft assigned for your flight may not have been able to fly to the specific destination, and the arrival of the replacement aircraft took longer than expected.
delay_customer_text.51: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to complete an unforeseen repair in the cabin or on the exterior of the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.52: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to complete an unforeseen repair in the cargo compartment of the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.56: This flight is delayed due to an issue with the cargo documentation needed for the flight.
delay_customer_text.58:
This flight is delayed due to an unforeseen technology issue impacting one of our suppliers, which is impacting our operations. 

An example of a technology issue could include an internet outage impacting airport terminal computers.
delay_customer_text.61: This flight is delayed due to additional flight preparation time needed by air traffic control to review the flight plan.
delay_customer_text.62: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to prepare the operational flight plan, which may mean the aircraft requires more fuel or that cargo needs to be removed.
delay_customer_text.63: This flight is delayed due to additional flight preparation time needed by the pilots.
delay_customer_text.64: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to address pilot scheduling issues.
delay_customer_text.65:
This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to address a request by the pilots. 

An example of a pilot request could include a maintenance check of the aircraft, additional items for the cabin crew, or extra fuel.
delay_customer_text.66: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed for the cabin crew to finalize the boarding procedures and prepare the aircraft for departure.
delay_customer_text.67: This flight is delayed due to additional flight preparation time needed by the cabin crew.
delay_customer_text.69: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to complete a security check on board the aircraft.
delay_customer_text.71:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather at the departure airport. 

An example of bad weather could include thunderstorms, snow, fog, low clouds, or wind gusts.
delay_customer_text.72:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather at the destination airport. 

An example of bad weather could include thunderstorms, snow, fog, low clouds, or wind gusts.
delay_customer_text.73:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather which has impacted the flight path for your journey.

An example of bad weather could include thunderstorms, snow, fog, low clouds, or wind gusts.
delay_customer_text.75:
This flight is delayed due to de-icing requirements. 

De-icing is a standard procedure that safely removes snow or frost from the aircraft exterior.
delay_customer_text.76:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather affecting airport operations. 

An example of bad weather could include the removal of snow, ice, water or sand from the runway or anywhere else on the airport grounds.
delay_customer_text.77:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather affecting airport ground handling operations. 

An example of bad weather could include thunderstorms, snow, fog, low clouds, or wind gusts.
delay_customer_text.81:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather on the flight path of your journey, which is contributing to air traffic constraints and slower processing times. 

An example of bad weather could include thunderstorms, snow, fog, low clouds, or wind gusts.
delay_customer_text.82:
This flight is delayed due to air traffic control constraints, which are resulting in slower processing times. 

An example of air traffic control restraint could include staff limitations or equipment issues.
delay_customer_text.83:
This flight is delayed due to air traffic control constraints at the destination airport, which are resulting in slower processing times. 

An example of air traffic control restraint could include staff limitations or equipment issues.
delay_customer_text.84:
This flight is delayed due to bad weather conditions at the destination airport. 

An example of bad weather could include thunderstorms, snow, fog, low clouds, or wind gusts.
delay_customer_text.85:
Your flight is delayed as security processes are taking longer than expected. 

Security process delays can happen if passengers arrive late, bags need to be removed for missed connections, or if there are long lines at airport screening areas.
delay_customer_text.86:
This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to accommodate government or regulatory restrictions.

Examples includes a country imposing airspace restrictions leading to longer flight times, government entry requirements that increase customs processing time, or local political developments that impact our operations.
delay_customer_text.87:
This flight is delayed due to airport limitations. 

An example of an airport limitation could include a technical issue with the jet bridge, baggage system or parking stand.
delay_customer_text.88:
This flight is delayed due to airport restrictions at the destination airport. 

An example of an airport restriction could include airport staff limitations, an airport curfew, or noise reduction constraints.
delay_customer_text.89:
This flight is delayed due to airport restrictions at the departure airport. 

An example of an airport restriction could include airport staff limitations, an airport curfew or noise reduction constraints.
delay_customer_text.93:
This flight is delayed due to an unforeseen operational constraints at the airport from an earlier flight which is causing the late arrival of the aircraft that is scheduled to operate. 

An example of an operational constraints at the airport could include ramp congestion, gate availability or a technical issue at the parking stand.
delay_customer_text.96:
This flight is delayed due to aircraft availability. 

An example of an aircraft availability issue could include the re-routing of an aircraft or the need to utilize a larger aircraft which requires longer preparation time.
delay_customer_text.97: This flight is delayed due to a labour dispute which is slowing down our operations.
delay_customer_text.98: This flight is delayed due to an external labour dispute affecting one of our suppliers which is slowing down our operations.
delay_customer_text.99: This flight is delayed due to additional time needed to tow the aircraft to the gate.
delay_customer_text.68:
This flight is delayed due to additional time needed for the cabin crew to finalize the boarding procedures and prepare the aircraft for departure.  

An example of an issue could be additional checks needed to assure all catering items are onboard the aircraft, or because the cabin crew needs time to investigate a cabin defect.
